The same SPR as a limped pot

questions.prompt: Top pair, good kicker, in a 3-bet pot at 100bb is often…

choices.text: Strong enough to continue and often to stack off on dry boards.
The same as bottom pair in a family pot

questions.explanation: The ranges are strong, so top pair good kicker is near the top, not a bluff-catcher only.

questions.prompt: Speculative hands that miss in a 3-bet pot should…

choices.text: Fold more. The price to continue is higher and implied odds are worse.
Call any bet because they were suited

questions.explanation: You already paid a 3-bet price. Missing does not entitle you to another street.

choices.text: Down versus single-raised pots. Both ranges are stronger.
Up, because the pot is bigger so bluffs always work
To zero even with the nuts

questions.explanation: Strong ranges call more and fold less. Value more, bluff less.
